summary: Iter 296 end-to-end verification of the system-wide UI/UX overhaul (Features rebuild, Guided Journeys glow-up on web + mobile, P2 backend expired-plan access_state guard, dark-mode legibility fix on Plan & Billing, Landing tweaks, premium Button primitive). action_items: (Data, not code) Re-seed trialactive@example.com so subscription_status='trialing', plan in ('solo','family'), trial_ends_at=now+5d so access_state=trial is deterministic. Prefer a Mongo update script rather than a code change.

Reactivate') is legible inside the teal card. Legibility fix confirmed.

rca of the issue: trialactive@example.com currently returns access_state=view_only instead of trial because the preview DB shows subscription_status='expired' + plan='free' (trial has already been consumed). Backend logic is correct — this is a stale fixture. To reproduce trial state deterministically, run: db.users.updateOne({email:'trialactive@example.com'}, {$set:{subscription_status:'trialing', plan:'family', trial_ends_at: <now+5d ISO>}}).
